items.name: Hatchet
items.description: This small axe can be used in close combat or thrown.

items.name: Shield Spikes
items.description: These metal spikes are strategically placed on the defensive side of the shield to deal piercing damage with a shield bash.

items.name: Half Plate
items.description: Half plate consists of most of the upper body plates used in full plate, with lighter or sparser steel plate protection for the arms and legs. This provides some of the protection of full plate with greater flexibility and speed. A suit of this armor comes with an undercoat of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Padded Armor] and a pair of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Gauntlet]{gauntlets}.

defensiveAbilities.name: Ferocity
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger The monster is reduced to 0 HP.

Effect The monster avoids being knocked out and remains at 1 HP, but its Wounded value increases by 1. When it is Wounded 3, it can no longer use this ability

defensiveAbilities.name: Shield Block
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger The monster has its shield raised and takes damage from a physical attack.

Effect The monster snaps its shield into place to deflect a blow. The shield prevents the monster from taking an amount of damage up to the shield's Hardness. The monster and the shield each take any remaining damage, possibly breaking or destroying the shield.

defensiveAbilities.name: Shield Warden
defensiveAbilities.description: When the shield bearer has their shield raised, they can Shield Block when an attack is made against an adjacent ally. If they do, the shield prevents that ally from taking damage instead of the shield bearer.

offensiveAbilities.name: Offensive Block
offensiveAbilities.description: The shield bearer can Step, make a shield spikes Strike, and Raise their Shield in any order.

offensiveAbilities.name: Retributive Bash
offensiveAbilities.description: The porphyry shield bearer deals an additional 1d8 damage with weapon Strikes against any creature that has damaged the shield bearer or an adjacent ally since the beginning of the shield bearer's last turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Tenacious Shield
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger The shield bearer's shield would be destroyed

Effect The shield is not destroyed and its Hit Points are instead reduced to 5.
